name: testkube-skills
description: Testkube skills for AI coding agents: learn what Testkube is and where its docs are, install or reuse the Testkube CLI and a local OSS agent, discover tests in a repository, author and validate TestWorkflow YAML, and run and diagnose TestWorkflow executions.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, install, discover, author, run, and diagnose Testkube from your AI agent
interface.longDescription: Six skills for working with Testkube from an AI coding agent: a general orientation skill that explains what Testkube is, indexes the official docs, and routes to the others; install or reuse the Testkube CLI; set up a local Testkube OSS agent; discover the tests in a cloned repository; author and validate TestWorkflow YAML; and run and diagnose TestWorkflow executions. Setup skills check for an existing install first and reuse it, installing missing pieces only after confirming each step with the user.
defaultPrompt: What is Testkube and how do I get started with it?
Install the Testkube CLI if it isn't already present.
Set up a local Testkube OSS agent, reusing my current cluster if it already has one.
Discover the tests in this repository and tell me what framework runs them.
Author a Testkube TestWorkflow YAML for my test suite.
Run my TestWorkflow and diagnose any failures.
